description:
Current apple tests (test-apple-git.sh, test-apple-jj.sh) are 21-line wrappers that delegate entirely to shared generic scenarios. No Apple-specific behaviors are tested.

Missing test coverage:
- Nix store availability in VM
- Generated file injection (once implemented)
- Port forwarding validation
- Environment variable propagation
- Container inspect JSON parsing correctness
- Command wrapping in /bin/sh -c (apple.go lines 309-312)
- Graceful shutdown timeout behavior
- Label-based orphan detection
- scenario_bidirectional_sync is commented out as flaky (scenarios.sh line 299)

Add apple-specific scenarios exercising features unique to the VM-based backend.
title: Integration tests: apple-specific test scenarios
